title: Multi-region gateway traffic orchestration for hosted API (session + streaming)
creator: Priya Nair
description: Problem statement: Our hosted API gateway needs an active-active traffic orchestration design that preserves SLOs during partial region failures while supporting long-lived sessions and streaming (gRPC/WebSocket) use cases. Current behavior routes by latency/geo but drops or reestablishes streaming sessions abruptly when a region loses capacity, causing 5xx bursts and user-perceived service disruption. We need a coordinated design: traffic shifting strategy, session-aware streaming handoff, circuit breaker thresholds and hysteresis, and probabilistic load-shedding to protect tokens/TPS budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Can shift traffic between primary and secondary regions using weighted gradual ramp with automated rollback on SLO regression
Streaming connections (gRPC/WebSocket) have a documented graceful handoff strategy with < 2% session loss in simulated region failover tests
Circuit breaker policies (per-route and per-tenant) implemented with metrics: open_count, open_duration, success_rate, and configurable hysteresis; defaults validated in staging
Load-shedding policy implemented that reduces non-essential work (low-priority batch/completions) while maintaining chat/generation latencies under SLO 95th percentile target
Runbook updated with step-by-step traffic-shift playbook, rollback criteria, and postmortem checklist
Integration tests covering: gradual traffic ramp, canary failover, forced region outage, and dual-region intermittent flapping pass in CI harness
tasks: Design: write detailed proposal for traffic orchestration (header-based routing, weight controllers, and session affinity annotations) — unblock by 2026-02-28
Implement control-plane API to adjust region weights and per-route session policies — PR #4392
Add streaming handoff library: checkpoint-based reconnect hints and backend sticky-lookup for KV cache resumption
Implement circuit-breaker middleware in edge gateway with pluggable policies and metrics emission
Implement probabilistic load shedding layer with config per-priority and telemetry to measure dropped request characteristics
Create chaos tests that simulate region slowdowns, partial resource exhaustion, and network partitions
Staging validation: run synthetic traffic and customer-mimic load across regions; capture SLO metrics and compare against baseline
Documentation: update runbook + Console playbooks for Ops and SREs
Coordinate with product: communicate possible UX impact and allow opt-in for strict session affinity for enterprise customers
